page: Amazon Web Services m7g.xlarge is a general-purpose cloud instance built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture and powered by the 64-bit ARM architecture. The instance is equipped with an AWS Graviton processor utilizing the ARMv8 Neoverse-V1 core design. Compute allocation consists of 4 dedicated physical cores operating at 2.6 GHz with one thread per core, eliminating performance variability associated with simultaneous multithreading. Cache resources comprise 64 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of shared L3 cache. Memory capacity totals 16.0 GB, establishing a standard 4.0 GB per vCPU ratio. The instance does not include integrated local NVMe storage or discrete GPU accelerators, operating with an external network-attached volume model and a baseline network throughput of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark results demonstrate balanced mid-tier execution across standardized multi-core processing and system memory routines. Synthetic testing yields a multi-core stress-ng score of 6,110.85 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 4,695.0. Memory throughput remains steady under load, recording 102.9 GB/sec in large uncached read operations and 39.89 GB/sec in write operations. In application-focused environments, the m7g.xlarge delivers 8.15 GB/sec of static web serving throughput, 6.65 million operations per second in Redis SET evaluations, and a score of 5,943.0 in software compilation using Clang.

Performance deficits appear in specialized compute operations and cryptographic processing. The processor registers lower scores in bzip3 multi-threaded decompression (26.22 GB/sec), Geekbench ray tracing (4,662.0), and PassMark encryption (553.23). Hardware instruction support is limited to standard ARM cryptography, lacking x86-specific vector extensions or advanced matrix accelerators, which constrains machine learning performance to 6.03 tokens per second on medium 7B model text generation. Given these execution metrics, the instance offers balanced resource efficiency for container clusters, microservices, mid-tier web serving, Redis caching, and continuous integration build nodes.
description: Amazon Web Services m7g.xlarge is a general-purpose cloud instance built on the AWS Nitro System and powered by 64-bit ARM Graviton Neoverse-V1 processors. It features 4 dedicated physical cores running at 2.6 GHz without multithreading, alongside 16.0 GB of system memory to maintain a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. The platform contains no integrated local storage or GPU hardware, providing a 2 Gbps baseline network throughput. Standardized benchmarks place the instance in the middle tier for general compute, compilation, Redis operations, and static web serving, with memory reads reaching 102.9 GB/sec. Lower performance is observed in complex decompression, advanced cryptographic tests, and local machine learning inference. The instance provides an efficient profile for mid-tier application backends, web serving, in-memory caching, and CI/CD pipelines.
